name: Aubrey
source:
Human class.
A quiet girl with a mature aura about her.
She cares about her friends and never hesitates to help when she sees someone struggling.
Despite her calm and cool demeanor, she can actually be quite clumsy. She sometimes misinterprets what others are saying and ends up doing some very strange things as a result.
